executive_summary.text: THREE RIVERS (075417): Operational / Managerial Control from 2014-12-14 to 2020-12-21; staffing during this period averaged 3.51 total nurse HPRD over 10 quarters.
DAVIS PLACE (075423): Operational / Managerial Control from 2014-12-14 to 2022-07-27; staffing during this period averaged 3.74 total nurse HPRD over 17 quarters.
In cost year 2021, homes linked to this company reported $184,520 in management fees on DSS cost reports.
